head: mi-167-pipeline-integrity-pass-2
title: MI-167 pass 2: the close executed; the confirmation asked the wrong question
body:
Standing pipeline-integrity lane under `CY-20260906-TRADING-TRUTH`, pass 2 of N. Builds on [MI-166 pass 1](https://github.com/benbaichmankass/Metis-Insights/pull/11265) (merged `39ab1079`).

**Measurement only.** No runtime, config, order-path, journal-write or protective-logic change. **No leg cancelled, no journal row edited.**

Verified live 2026-09-07 18:53-19:03Z. `read_state=orders_read` checked before any conclusion from the order list, `error=null` before any conclusion from a position list. Running SHA == on-disk SHA, `restart_pending` false - pass 1's confound is gone.

---

## The finding, and it inverts pass 1

Pass 1 concluded *"the journal recorded a 43-lot fill it does not have."* **The journal recorded a fill it did have, and then missed the close.** Same divergence, opposite repair.

| when (UTC) | what |
|---|---|
| 08:26:33 | `MarketOrder(orderId=538, BUY, totalQuantity=43.0)` - position climbs **11 -> 54** |
| 10:01 - 11:43 | position **54.0**, `avgCost 44230.21925925` |
| **11:45:01** | `order_monitor ... verdict={'action': 'close', 'reason': 'sl_cross'}` |
| 11:45:06 | `orderStatus 547: status='Filled', filled=43.0, remaining=0.0, avgFillPrice=4392.9` -> **54 -> 11** |
| **11:45:09** | `exchange close failed - leaving DB open ... close not confirmed flat: live_qty=11.0` |
| 11:55:20 | protection **re-arms 43 lots** over a position that no longer exists |

**Root cause.** `IBClient.close` confirms by requiring the whole **symbol** to reach flat (`_live_position_qty(sym) <= 0`), but the close was of one **trade**. Sibling trade 5353 legitimately held 11 MGC lots, so the gate could never confirm - it graded a perfectly executed close a failure and left the row open *by design*. `live_qty=11.0` is **correct**; it answers *"is this symbol flat?"* and was used to answer *"did trade 5531 close?"* - pass 1's framing, recurring exactly.

The gate's own history makes the symmetry explicit: it was added by `BL-20260707` to stop a false-**success** that journaled *"a FABRICATED local mark-to-market PnL."* The fix installed a false-**failure**. Only the sign changed.

## Blast radius - the dispatch ranked this first, and the answer is no

Stated with a positive control (`grep -rn "BYBIT_CLOSE_CONFIRM"` -> **0**; the same probe finds IB and Alpaca):

- **`bybit_2` (real money): NOT exposed** - Bybit has no close-confirmation at all. There is no gate to misfire.
- **`alpaca_live` (real money): exposed in code, inert in behaviour** - shares the identical symbol-scoped gate, but holds nothing (venue `positions: []`, `error: null`) and **all 44** of its journal rows in the window are `rejected`. **Its only protection is that it cannot place orders - fixing MI-140 arms this defect on real money.**
- `ib_live`: `dry_run`, no strategies. `breakout_1`: **not checked**, stated as not-looked.

## The operator's PnL question

**Population: all 1000 rows, ids 4540-5539, 2026-08-10 -> 2026-09-07.** 187 of 572 closed rows (32.7%) closed while a same-symbol sibling was open - **but all 187 are Bybit**, which has no such gate. **Zero closed-trade PnL in this window is corrupted by this defect** - *we looked and it is not there*. Three limits on that negative are stated in the doc.

What *is* wrong is an omission: trade 5531's realised **-$17,024.28** (43 x (4392.9 - 4432.491349) x mult 10) is absent from the book while 43 phantom lots still count as open exposure. Per `CLAUDE.md` provenance rules, any `ict_scalp_mgc_15m` expectancy/R figure today is **FABRICATED, not estimated**.

## Live hazard - a decision for the operator, not an action I took

MGC still carries **54 resting stop lots over an 11-lot position (491%)**, re-verified 18:54:42Z. The oversized `oca-protect-t5531` holds the **tighter** stop, so it fires first -> **net short ~32**. Pass 2 adds a **second route**: the monitor's `sl_cross` can fire again and place *another* 43-lot SELL. Neither route guards the other. **Paper money only.**

Three remediation options are put to the operator; **none was taken**, per `BL-20260820-OVERCOVER-REMEDIATION-CANCELLED-THE-JOURNAL-MATCHING-LEG`. Note that pass 1's caution is now doubly justified - the alarm's remedy text says *"cancel the leg that does NOT match `trades.stop_loss`"*, both legs match, and the matching leg covers a **closed** trade. A responder following that text has no correct move.

## Tier-3 fix - proposed in prose only, no code written

Re-scope the gate to confirm a **reduction of the close's own quantity** rather than symbol flatness, at three sites (`ib_client.py:2636`, `alpaca_client.py:842` and `:1049`), preserving the refusal discipline (a read failure still is not confirmation). **Do not simply delete the gate** - it exists for a real defect that fabricated PnL in the other direction. One design question (whether a partial reduction should confirm) is a risk decision left to the operator.

---
